description: Whether seats are left on a domestic flight of Mandarin Airlines (AE), UNI Air (B7) or Daily Air (DA): available, fewer than 5 left, or sold out, per cabin when the airline says. TDX asks the airline live, so this can take up to 30 s, and UNI Air allows few requests; call it for one flight at a time. Example: flight "AE1273", date "2026-11-02".

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

flight.description: Domestic flight with its airline code: AE, B7 or DA, e.g. "AE1273", "B7 8751".

name: flight_seats
title: Domestic flight seats
